heavy:
TDA_AskUser — stop and ask the user ONE question when the answer changes what you do and neither the conversation nor your tools can give it.

Required: kind — choose (one of listed options) · provide (a typed value) · confirm (yes/no on a named step); question — one sentence the user reads (at most 300 characters). Optional: why — what it blocks, one sentence; options (choose only) — 2–8, each a string or {value, label, detail}, values unique; schema (provide only) — a flat schema of one primitive field (string with format date/date-time/email/uri · number · integer · boolean · enum).

After the call the turn ends: end your answer by asking the question as written and call no further tools; the user's answer continues this request in the next turn. A second call in the same turn is refused. Never ask for a password, API key, token or payment detail — credentials go through the platform's own flows. Do not use emoji.
